'''Market Ward''' was a marketplace located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wielu]].<ref name="The Smuggler's Code" />

In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Rook Pryce]] took [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]  [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to the Market Ward to gather information on the criminal he was pursuing.<ref name="The Smuggler's Code" />
